name: infohub
description: InfoHub -> InovAMF: frontend + backend num único deploy (o Express serve o build do React)

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix infohub-frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix infohub-frontend && npm ci --prefix infohub-backend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix infohub-backend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
